domain.primary_user_question: How do structural energy shifts and resource scarcity impact supply chain stability and inflation?

signal.title: TEST Hormuz Strait shipping lane watch

executive_summary: This brief tracks a Energy & Resource Risk signal related to TEST Hormuz Strait shipping lane watch, classified as energy supply disruption. Secondary signal dimensions include maritime chokepoint, petro fx sensitivity, commodity repricing. Market confirmation is strongly confirming (supply-driven) across energy producers (confirming), oil price proxy (confirming), transport sensitivity (resilient), petro fx (confirming). Data coverage is strong across most source categories. Geographic scope includes United States, Russia, Iran (inferred attribution). Structural risk indicators are elevated while market confirmation remains incomplete.
key_findings: Physical crude up with US inventory draw — supply-driven confirmation
Geo scope: United States, Russia, Iran

signal_classification.rationale: Related events point to oil export disruption and tanker route risk rather than a pure demand shock.
